page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. The server is equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. It features 64.0 GB of system memory, which provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not feature any local storage, meaning operating systems and application data must rely entirely on external network-attached storage solutions. Additionally, the instance does not include integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a stable resource density for standard business applications without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The primary tradeoff is the reliance on external storage, which may affect I/O-intensive operations compared to instances with local NVMe drives. The instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application hosting, container orchestration, and database management.
